title: Creativity can have an...
fullPassage: Creativity can have an effect on productivity. Creativity leads some individuals to recognize problems that others do not see, but which may be very difficult. ( ) Charles Darwin's approach to the speciation problem is a good example of this; he chose a very difficult and tangled problem, speciation, and this led him to a long period of data collection and contemplation. ( ) His productivity was low, as indicated by a relatively low number of publications, but the importance of his work was enormous. ( ) In other cases, creativity may be expressed such that a large number of products result. ( ) Thomas Edison was, for instance, awarded 1,093 patents. ( ) It is also possible that creative efforts are invested but are not productive at all.
givenSentence: For others, whose creativity is more focused on methods and technique, creativity may lead to solutions that drastically reduce the work necessary to solve a problem.
